search ItemBySku on items (rows model.Items)
  read       items; root; nullable weight, released_on, local_at, opens_at, deleted_at, external_id, tags; tenant tenant_id
  map        Map(summarize)
  scope      Scope items.tenant_id
  filter     Status: Eq, In on items.status (item_status, model.ItemStatus)
  filter     Sku: In (skus) on items.sku (text, sku)
  filter     CreatedAt: Range.HalfOpen (created_since, created_until) on items.created_at (timestamptz, time.Time)
  filter     DeletedAt: Present on items.deleted_at (timestamptz, time.Time), Go only
  sort       name: items.name
  sort       created_at: items.created_at
  default    items.created_at DESC
  tiebreak   sku, id: covers items_pkey (id)
  limit      50
search ItemByTenantSku on items (rows model.Items)
  read       items; root; nullable weight, released_on, local_at, opens_at, deleted_at, external_id, tags; tenant tenant_id
  tiebreak   tenant_id, sku, id: covers items_pkey (id)
search ItemWithTenant on items (rows model.Items)
  from       itemsWithTheirTenant
  read       items; root; nullable weight, released_on, local_at, opens_at, deleted_at, external_id, tags; tenant tenant_id
  read       tenants; INNER JOIN; ON table.Tenants.ID.EQ(table.Items.TenantID)
  map        MapPage(summarizePage)
  scope      Scope items.tenant_id, tenants.id
  scope      ScopeFunc tenantFilter on tenants.name
  scope      Unscoped items.tenant_id: fixture
  condition  expensive()
  filter     Name: Contains on items.name (text, string)
  filter     Expensive: Is on expensive()
  filter     TenantName: Eq on tenantName()
  fulltext   items.name (text)
  fulltext   tenants.name (text)
  fulltext   tenantName()
  sort       tenant_name, tenant: tenants.name, NullsLast
  sort       total: field Total = total()
  sort       popularity: hand-written
  default    Total ASC
  tiebreak   id: the primary key items_pkey (id), by default
search TenantItem on tenants (rows model.Tenants)
  from       tenantsAndTheirItems
  read       tenants; root
  read       items; LEFT JOIN; ON table.Items.TenantID.EQ(table.Tenants.ID); every column nullable; tenant tenant_id
  filter     Name: Present on items.name (text, string)
  sort       created_at: items.created_at, nullable
  sort       name: tenants.name
  default    tenants.name ASC
  tiebreak   id: the primary key tenants_pkey (id), by default
